page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The processor includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. Additionally, the server includes 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the D64ads_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, achieving a top-tier rating in Geekbench multi-core performance. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests both rank in the top 25%. Memory performance is characterized by strong read-only small block cached bandwidth and strong write large block bandwidth, though uncached large block read bandwidth falls into the average category. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported by hardware-accelerated instruction sets such as AVX-512, AES, and SHA-NI. The instance also shows strong performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-capacity local NVMe SSD, this server offers a cost-efficient profile for resource-dense workloads that require fast local scratch space without the overhead of external storage. It is highly suited for database hosting, multi-threaded software compilation, high-throughput web serving, and moderate language model inference tasks, such as prompt processing and text generation for smaller models.
